newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling amid cash crunch.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling amid cash crunch.

text.p: Bear-run is expected to continue on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) on Monday as the bourse suffers from cash crunch amid tightening bank credit, brokers said.
"The market is suffering from instability mainly due to tight liquidity. Investors are being denied of (bank) credit," said broker Khurshid Alam.
He said share prices might not rise unless institutional buying was regular. "Their (institutions') presence is very much irregular."
The DSE all-share price index lost 9.16 points or 0.94 percent to 963.97 on Sunday. Friday and Saturday mark the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
